spans.s:
mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं)
Tailless.
f. (-च्छा)
A tree, (Dalbergia sisu.) See शिंशपा.
E.
अ neg. पुच्छ a tail.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
Wicked, bad.
E.
अ, and पुण्य virtuous. So अपुण्यशील.

mfn. (-त्)
Acting wickedly, wicked, bad.
E.
कृत् who does, with अपुण्य. So अपुण्यवत्.

m. (-त्रं)
A man who has no son.
E.
अ neg. पुत्र a son, also with कन added, अपुत्रकः.

f. (-त्तिः)
Final exemption from life.
E.
अ neg. पुनरावृत्ति renewed practice.

m. (-वः)
Final beatitude, exemption of the soul from further transmigration.
E.
अ neg. पुनर् again, and भव being.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Modern, new. So अपुरातन.
E.
अ neg. पुराण old.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Unmanly.
E.
अ neg. पुरुष a man.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Lean.
E.
अ neg. पुष्ट nourished.

mfn. (-ष्पः-ष्पा-ष्पं)
Not flowering.
E.
अ neg. पुष्प a flower. So अपुष्पक and अपुष्पित.

m. (-दः)
Any tree which bears fruit without flowering, as the jack tree.
E.
अपुष्प, फल fruit, and द what gives.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Irreligious, irreverent.
E.
अ neg. पूजक a worshipper.

f. (-जा)
Irreverence, disrespect.
E.
अ neg. पूजा worship.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Contemned, disregarded, not reverenced or worshipped.
E.
अ neg. पूजित worshipped.

Impure.
2

Not having received the invocatory rite.
E.
अ neg. पूत pure.

m. (-पः)
1 Cake of flour, meal, &c.
2 Wheat.
E.
पूय to split with अ neg. prefixed; प affixed, and य dropped.

m. (-प्यः)
Flour, meal.
E.
अपूप a cake, and यत् aff.

m. (-प्यः)
Flour, meal.
E.
अपूप a cake, यञ् aff.

f. (-णी)
The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Incomplete, not full or entire.
m. (-णः)
A fraction.
2 An incomplete number.
E.
अ neg. पूर्ण full.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Premature.
m. (-लः)
Incomplete time.
E.
अपूर्ण, and काल time.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Abortive, born before the proper time.
E.
अपूर्ण, and काल time, and ज born.

f. (-ता)
Incompleteness.
E.
अपूर्ण and तल् affix; also with त्व, अपूर्णत्वं.

mfn. (-व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
1 Wonderful, extraordinary.
2 Unprecedented, unpreceded.
3 Excellent, not exceeded.
4 Not easterly.
n. (-र्व्वं)
The remote or unforeseen consequence of an act, as heaven of religious rites, a consequence not immediately preceded by its cause.
E.
अ neg. पूर्व्व prior.

ind.
Singularly, unlike any thing else.
E.
अपूर्व्व and वति aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 A baker.
2 A confectioner.
3 One who eats cakes, one for whom they are good, &c.
n. (-कं)
A multitude of cakes.
E.
अपप a cake, ठक् or ठञ् aff.

Filling.
2

Satisfaction, fulness.
E.
आङ् before पूर्त्ति fulness.

n. (-षं)
Tin.
